call.query:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `test-project.agent_analytics.v_user_message_received` AS
SELECT
  timestamp,
  event_id,
  event_type,
  agent,
  session_id,
  invocation_id,
  user_id,
  trace_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  error_message,
  is_truncated
FROM
  `test-project.agent_analytics.agent_events`
WHERE
  event_type = 'USER_MESSAGE_RECEIVED'
